mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline in prior month correlates with negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in >50% of instances over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increase >0.3pp in 3 months produces positive 20-day returns in >40% of cases over 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue forecasts, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST and RSAFS growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >50% of instances over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During early expansion phases, rising industrial production indicates improving manufacturing conditions that increase corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth in early expansion phases correlates with negative 60-day S&P 500 returns in >50% of cases over 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL >2.5% produces positive 5-day returns in >40% of cases over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls over three months indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth in prior three months correlates with negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in >50% of instances over 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery periods, rising housing starts signals renewed consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth in post-recession recovery phases correlates with negative 60-day S&P 500 returns in >50% of cases over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production and real GDP indicates robust economic expansion that increases corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint INDPRO and GDPC1 growth fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >50% of instances over 5-year rolling window.
